title.narrative: East Asian Biosphere Reserves and UNESCO Global Geoparks for advancing and applying science for sustainable management of natural resources, ecosystem and biodiversity conservation and restoration through local and indigenous knowledge.

description.narrative: This workplan covers the 5MS in EA with frameworks designed to be transposable to Africa and SIDS and includes 2 EXB. Utilizing East Asian BRs and UGGps, the workplan prioritizes strengthening Mongolian and DPRK sites, ecotourism integration with the Culture sector, and follow-up initiatives from the first Asia-Pacific MAB Youth Forum and develop the regional implementation strategy to align EABRN activities with the implementation of the HSAP. 2026 activities will also focus to strategically link with the UNCCD COP17 in Ulaanbaatar. This includes leveraging East Asian pilot sites to celebrate the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists (IYRP 2026) during the August COP17 high-level sessions.
